node_start_sanctuary.title: Node 1: The Shattered Threshold
node_start_sanctuary.desc: You wake beneath the weeping arches of the Ink Cathedral. A scarred Inquisitor in hybrid obsidian-and-lace vestments blocks the stairway to the Megastructure elevator.

choices.text: Draw blade & challenge the Gilded Veil Apostate
Descend into the Blame! Megastructure shaft

node_boss_veil_duel.title: Node 2: The Gilded Veil Duel
node_boss_veil_duel.desc: The Gilded Veil Boss descends in a storm of porcelain lilies and gold filigree. Her ritual blade hums with cathedral resonance.

choices.text: Shatter her posture & claim the Cathedral Relic
Spare her & pursue the Silicon Nomad into the Abyss

node_megastructure_descent.title: Node 3: The Abyssal Megastructure (Blame!)
node_megastructure_descent.desc: Cold cyan fog rolls across brutalist megastructure bridges. The Silicon Nomad intercepts your path with Sandevistan afterimages.

choices.text: Overload the reactor & ascend to the Gothic Eclipse
Return to the Ink Cathedral Sanctuary
Cross the megastructure bridge to the overseer post

node_eclipse_summit.title: Node 4: The Gothic Eclipse Convergence
node_eclipse_summit.desc: Beneath a blood-red eclipsed sun, your intertwined paths collide. The Eclipse Sovereign awaits at the shattered altar for the final duel.

choices.text: Begin New Cycle (Keep Unlocks & Replay)
Draw blade & challenge the Inquisitor at the threshold
Return to the Cathedral choir alleyway
Descend to the eclipse gargoyle alcove
Climb the eclipse bell tower

node_cathedral_choir_nave.title: Node 5: The Choir Nave Accusation
node_cathedral_choir_nave.desc: The nave lights fail one by one. A masked choir priest with a censer of black incense steps from the confession alcove and names you heretic before you can kneel.

choices.text: Break his censer stance & silence the nave
Slip past him into the Ink Cathedral crypt

node_cathedral_crypt_descent.title: Node 6: The Ink Cathedral Crypt
node_cathedral_crypt_descent.desc: Black water laps at the crypt steps. A sepulcher inquisitor in rusted plate waits below with a hammer wired to a dead saint's cable.

choices.text: Break the cable saint & take the crypt key
Flee up the crypt ladder to the Megastructure shaft

node_megastructure_bridge_defense.title: Node 7: The Megastructure Bridge Guard
node_megastructure_bridge_defense.desc: A netherworld overseer in a cracked exosuit pins you to the bridge railing with a mag-rail spear. Beyond the rail, the megastructure drops into a shaft of dead cabling.

choices.text: Sever the mag-rail spear & cross the bridge
Drop off the bridge back to the Ink Cathedral shaft

node_megastructure_core_descent.title: Node 8: The Megastructure Core Descent
node_megastructure_core_descent.desc: At the core well, a siren in salvaged veil rigging hammers the control cage with a monofilament whip. The reactor hum turns into a scream.

choices.text: Kill the siren & overload the core yourself
Drop the cage ladder back to the Megastructure bridge

node_eclipse_gargoyle_alcove.title: Node 9: The Eclipse Gargoyle Alcove
node_eclipse_gargoyle_alcove.desc: A gargoyle keeper of the eclipse perches in the ruined alcove with a stone-carved mace. The eclipsed sky bleeds through the shattered nave roof above.

choices.text: Knock the keeper off the alcove & take the eclipse shard
Descend the eclipse stairwell back to the cathedral choir

node_eclipse_bell_tower.title: Node 10: The Eclipse Bell Tower
node_eclipse_bell_tower.rival_name: TOLLING ABBOT OF THE BLOOD SUN
node_eclipse_bell_tower.desc: The cathedral bell tolls once for every name carved in the ash. At the tower stairhead, the Tolling Abbot in smoke-black robes waits with a priestbreaker drawn from the church's dead iron.

choices.text: Cut the bell rope & break his prayer stance
Drop through the tower floor into the nave crypt
